text: Penske Automotive Italy was founded in February 2012 as a joint venture between Penske Automotive Group and the Vanti-Mantellini families, per the Italian branch's own website.
short: Penske Automotive Italy is a joint venture of Penske Automotive Group and the Vanti-Mantellini families.

source.quote: Penske Automotive Italy, nata nel febbraio 2012 dalla joint venture tra Penske Automotive Group e le famiglie Vanti-Mantellini
